_A_VALIDATED_JSON_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: AValidatedJson is a component for editing structured data with validation rules. It supports single-item, list, and JSON modes and helps users manage complex form data safely.
_A_VALIDATED_JSON_COMPONENT_PRIMITIVE_LI: Use mode="list" with value-key="value" to edit an array of primitive values, such as strings. The child field with id="value" defines the editor for each item, while the model remains a simple array, such as ["Aloha", "Vue"]. The example also shows duplicate validation with unique-children-ids and a read-only view of the same data.
